subject: Request: Short-term GTM coverage surge + comp-band exception for EMEA expansion
body:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Short-term GTM coverage surge + comp-band exception for EMEA expansion

Hi team,

Quick ask: we have an accelerated expansion request from Boxwell (EMEA) tied to a potential upsell + three inbound partner deals that will require additional SDR/SE and a senior CS hire to maintain SLOs for Q4 delivery. Headline ask: approval to stand up a 60-day coverage surge (2 x Solutions Engineer ICs, 1 x Senior Customer Success Manager) and permission for a temporary comp-band uplift on the SE role (+12% above published band) to secure two senior contractors/perm-conversions.

Why now (short):
- Boxwell expansion: $2.4M ARR expansion opportunity, delivery window Oct-Nov; they require single-vendor support model with dedicated SE coverage.
- Partner-led pipeline: three reseller-led deals pending technical validation that we can only resource if we allocate senior SE time.
- CS risk: account health flags around onboarding velocity; with current headcount we expect >2 week SLA slippage.

Proposed ask:
- Approve 3 headcount equivalents (contractor conversions allowed): 2 SEs (12-week ramp), 1 Sr. CSM (6-week ramp)
- Temporary comp-band exception for SE hires: base up to +12% band for quickly available senior candidates; total comp not to exceed manager approval cap (see attached comp_band_proposal_Q3-2026.xlsx).
- Funding: use Q3 GTM contingency pool (line item HR-1298). If not approved, recommend delaying Boxwell expansion or offering scaled pilot.

Attachments: headcount_request_onepager.pdf, comp_band_proposal_Q3-2026.xlsx (band details and budget impact).

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik - confirm budget routing and if we can draw from contingency.
2) Marcus - confirm hiring channel (engage recruiting desk + allow contractor-to-hire conversion).
3) Marissa - confirm expected ARR capture plan and KPIs you want the hires to hit in 90 days.

Happy to jump on a short sync — flagged as urgent because Boxwell has requested a start week of 10/05.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Short-term GTM coverage surge + comp-band exception for EMEA expansion

Irene — thanks for the concise ask. I support this and will own the 90-day targets:
- SEs: enable Boxwell PoC + three partner proofs -> target $2.4M expansion motion; technical gateway metric = completion of integration playbook within 30 days.
- Sr. CSM: reduce onboarding time by 40% for the expansion cohort; risk mitigation KPI = 0 critical escalations in first 45 days.

If we can get the SEs in place the week of 10/05 we can keep Boxwell on track. I’m comfortable with the temporary band uplift as long as Finance signs off. Marcus — recruiting will need a quick shortlist by 09/15.

-Marissa
VP, Sales Engineering

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Short-term GTM coverage surge + comp-band exception for EMEA expansion

Thanks Irene — quick clarifying Qs before I route funding:
1) Please confirm the expected incremental ARR attribution model (how much of the $2.4M is attributable to these hires vs. sales motions we already have). I need a conservative ARR attribution to include in the costing.
2) For the comp-band uplift: is this one-time sign-on/market adjustment or an ongoing band rebase? Finance will only approve temporary market adjustments or sign-on bonuses, not permanent rebasing, without exec sign-off.
3) Do we have preferred contractors from recruiting to convert (this affects cost model)?

If we can get those answers by EOD tomorrow I’ll escalate to Finance and circulate a one-page approval template for the contingency draw. Budget target: keep all-in delta < $120k for Q4 run rate.

-Karthik
Head of GTM Finance & Operations

---

From: Sarah Bennett <sarah@boxwell-recruiting.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate: Alex James — senior SE (EMEA) — availability and CV

Hi Irene/Marissa/Marcus/Karthik,

Per our earlier call, attaching Alex James’ CV (candidate_alex_james_resume.pdf). Alex is UK-based, 7 years experience in enterprise LLM deployments, and available to start on contract Sept 27 with a potential conversion timeline mid-November. He’s worked directly with Boxwell in a previous role and has the required regional experience — can do in-person visits in Amsterdam week of 10/12 if that helps.

Key notes:
- Expected day-rate if contracted through Boxwell-recruiting: GBP 650/day (converted in comp_band_proposal_Q3-2026.xlsx impact sheet).
- Candidate prefers conversion to perm; we should allow a sign-on bonus structure in lieu of raising base band permanently.

Proposed next steps from our side:
1) Quick 30-min technical screen with Marissa the week of 09/06.
2) Marcus to confirm recruiting brief and if Redwood can engage contractor-to-perm clause.
3) Karthik to confirm budget sign-off window so we can lock the candidate.

Regards,
Sarah Bennett
Senior Recruiter, Boxwell Recruiting (external partner)
